        .route(
            "/assistant/config",
            get(handlers::openclaw::openclaw_config_handler),
        )
        .route(
            "/assistant/chat",
            post(handlers::openclaw::openclaw_chat_handler),
        )

            get(handlers::openclaw::openclaw_models_handler),

            "/mcp/cognitive/memory/stats",
            get(handlers::mcp::memory_stats_handler),

        .route("/mcp/_config", get(mcp::config_handler))
        // SSE events
        .route("/events", get(sse::sse_handler))
        // Privacy router endpoints
        .route("/privacy/signup", post(handlers::privacy::signup))
        .route("/privacy/verify", get(handlers::privacy::verify))
        .route(
            "/privacy/config/{user_id}",

        .route("/privacy/status", get(handlers::privacy::status))

        .fallback(api_not_found);

    let agents_mcp_route = Router::new()

    let ws_route = Router::new().route("/ws", get(websocket::websocket_handler));

        .route("/rpc", post(mcp::jsonrpc_handler))

        // Phase 2 FR-2a: enforce zone/Ghostbridge on `/mcp` nest only (not global).
        .nest(
            "/mcp",
            mcp_route.layer(axum::middleware::from_fn(
                security::mcp_ingress_auth_middleware,
            )),
        )
        .merge(ws_route)
        // Well-known discovery endpoint for auto-configuration
        .route(
            "/.well-known/mcp.json",
            get(mcp_discovery::mcp_discovery_handler),
        )
        .nest("/groups-admin", groups_admin::create_groups_admin_router())
        .nest("/admin", admin::admin_routes());

    // Phase 2: context-awareness SSE routes (in-process, no :3003 proxy).
    // Cozo/RocksDB is single-writer — bridge owns memory.db for ToolRegistry.
    // When op-web cannot open that DB, still expose JSON health (not SPA HTML).
    let mut router = router;
    if let Some((context_engine, memory_store, session_manager)) = state.cognitive_context_state() {
        let context_router = build_context_router(context_engine, memory_store, session_manager);
        router = router.nest("/cognitive/context", context_router);
    } else {
        router = router.route(
            "/cognitive/context/health",
            get(|| async {
                (
                    axum::http::StatusCode::OK,
                    [(axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/json")],
                    serde_json::json!({
                        "status": "degraded",
                        "mode": "bridge",
                        "detail": "CozoDB locked by op-grpc-bridge; tools/context run in-process there (socket / :8090)",
                    })
                    .to_string(),
                )
            }),
        );
    }

    // Serve the pinned Lovable dashboard while keeping `/api`, `/mcp`, and
    // websocket routes on this same origin. Client-side routes fall back to
    // index.html. gRPC-Web calls (see `grpc_proxy::is_grpc_request` — routed
    // by Content-Type, not a path allowlist) are forwarded to loopback-only
    // op-grpc-bridge instead, so the dashboard's gRPC client can resolve
    // same-origin (whatever interface this request arrived on — localhost,
    // svc0/NetMaker, or the public domain) with no hardcoded upstream host
    // baked into the frontend build.
    let static_dir = std::env::var("OP_WEB_STATIC_DIR")
        .unwrap_or_else(|_| "/usr/local/share/op-dbus/dashboard".to_string());
    let spa =
        ServeDir::new(&static_dir).fallback(ServeFile::new(format!("{static_dir}/index.html")));

    let spa_or_grpc = move |req: axum::extract::Request| {
        let spa = spa.clone();
        async move {
            if crate::grpc_proxy::is_grpc_request(&req) {
                crate::grpc_proxy::proxy(req).await
            } else {
                use tower::ServiceExt;
                match spa.oneshot(req).await {
                    Ok(resp) => resp.into_response(),
                    Err(err) => {
                        tracing::error!(?err, "spa serve error");
                        axum::http::StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.into_response()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    };

    router
        .fallback(spa_or_grpc)
        .layer(Extension(state))
        .layer(axum::middleware::from_fn(security::ip_security_middleware))
        .layer(axum::middleware::from_fn(
            crate::middleware::access_log::access_log_middleware,
        ))
        .layer(axum::middleware::from_fn(
            crate::middleware::spa_cache::spa_cache_middleware,
        ))
        .layer(cors)
        .layer(CompressionLayer::new())
        .layer(TraceLayer::new_for_http())
}

async fn api_not_found() -> impl IntoResponse {
    (
        StatusCode::NOT_FOUND,
        Json(serde_json::json!({
            "error": "API route not found",
        })),
    )
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::api_not_found;
    use axum::{
        body::{to_bytes, Body},
        http::{header::CONTENT_TYPE, Request, StatusCode},
        response::Html,
        Router,
    };
    use tower::ServiceExt;

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn missing_api_route_does_not_fall_through_to_spa() {
        let app = Router::new()
            .nest("/api", Router::new().fallback(api_not_found))
            .fallback(|| async { Html("spa index") });

        let response = app
            .oneshot(
                Request::builder()
                    .uri("/api/definitely-missing")
                    .body(Body::empty())
                    .unwrap(),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();

        assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
        assert_eq!(
            response.headers().get(CONTENT_TYPE).unwrap(),
            "application/json"
        );
        let body = to_bytes(response.into_body(), usize::MAX).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(body, r#"{"error":"API route not found"}"#);
    }
}

## Adding the `generate_plugin_page` Endpoint

### 1. Route Mounting Location

The gallery-gen routes are mounted in `/srv/git/odbus/crates/op-web/src/routes/mod.rs` (lines 108-121):

```rust
// Gallery generation API (model-agnostic)
.route(
    "/gallery-gen/start",
    post(handlers::ui_model::start_generation),
)
.route(
    "/gallery-gen/stop",
    post(handlers::ui_model::stop_generation),
)
.route(
    "/gallery-gen/stream",
    get(handlers::ui_model::generation_stream),
)
```

Your new endpoint should be added in this same block:
```rust
.route(
    "/gallery-gen/generate-plugin-page",
    post(handlers::ui_model::generate_plugin_page),
)
```

### 2. AppState Structure

`AppState` is defined in `/srv/git/odbus/crates/op-web/src/state.rs` (lines 65-115). Key fields for your endpoint:

- `chat_manager: Arc<ChatManager>` — LLM access (not directly needed; inference uses ZeroClaw endpoint)
- `grpc_client: Arc<RemoteOperationClient>` — for remote operations if needed
- No direct `CatalogGuard` or `InferenceLoop` in AppState — these are created per-request from `op_gallery_gen`

### 3. Required Imports from `op_gallery_gen`

From `/srv/git/odbus/crates/op-gallery-gen/src/lib.rs` and its modules:

```rust
use op_gallery_gen::{
    // Context types
    context::{GenerationContext, TargetPluginContext, SchemaPayload},
    // Inference
    InferenceLoop,
    // Validation
    CatalogGuard, GalleryGenConfig,
    // Load catalog from SHM
    context::load_from_shm,
};
```

### 4. Building `TargetPluginContext`

The `TargetPluginContext` struct is defined in `/srv/git/odbus/crates/op-gallery-gen/src/context.rs` (lines 82-87):

```rust
pub struct TargetPluginContext {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub projections: Vec<op_state_store::subid_ui::UiSubidProjection>,
    pub ui_surfaces: UiSurfaceProjection,
}
```

To build it:

1. **Read plugin schema** from sealed blob catalog:
   ```rust
   let schema = op_blob::catalog::read_plugin_schema_shm(&plugin_id)
       .ok_or_else(|| format!("plugin schema not found: {}", plugin_id))?;
   ```

2. **Get UI projections** via `op_state_store::subid_ui::project_schema_ui`:
   ```rust
   let projections = op_state_store::subid_ui::project_schema_ui(&plugin_id, &schema);
   ```

3. **Extract UI surfaces** — these come from the `SchemaPayload` which is built inside `op_gallery_gen::context`. When loading via `load_from_shm()`, the `ui_surfaces` field on each `SchemaPayload` is populated from the schema's `ui_surfaces` field (lines 323-340 in context.rs).

### 5. Full Implementation Pattern

Based on the existing `start_generation` handler (ui_model.rs lines 311-385) and how `GenerationContext` works:

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
pub struct GeneratePluginPageRequest {
    pub plugin_id: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
#[serde(untagged)]
pub enum GeneratePluginPageResponse {
    Success { spec: serde_json::Value, valid: bool },
    Error { errors: Vec<String> },
}

pub async fn generate_plugin_page(
    Extension(_state): Extension<Arc<AppState>>,
    Json(body): Json<GeneratePluginPageRequest>,
) -> Response {
    // 1. Read plugin schema from blob catalog
    let schema = match op_blob::catalog::read_plugin_schema_shm(&body.plugin_id) {
        Some(s) => s,
        None => return err(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, &format!("plugin not found: {}", body.plugin_id)),
    };

    // 2. Get UI projection via project_schema_ui
    let projections = op_state_store::subid_ui::project_schema_ui(&body.plugin_id, &schema);

    // 3. Load full catalog context for GenerationContext
    let catalog_load = match op_gallery_gen::context::load_from_shm() {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => return err(StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, &format!("catalog load failed: {}", e)),
    };

    // Find the target plugin's SchemaPayload for ui_surfaces
    let target_schema = catalog_load.schemas.iter()
        .find(|s| s.name == body.plugin_id)
        .cloned();
    
    let ui_surfaces = target_schema
        .map(|s| s.ui_surfaces.clone())
        .unwrap_or_default();

    // 4. Build TargetPluginContext
    let target_plugin = op_gallery_gen::context::TargetPluginContext {
        plugin_id: body.plugin_id.clone(),
        projections,
        ui_surfaces,
    };

    // 5. Load catalog guard for validation
    let config = op_gallery_gen::GalleryGenConfig::default();
    let catalog_guard = match config.load_catalog() {
        Ok(g) => g,
        Err(e) => return err(StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, &format!("catalog guard load failed: {}", e)),
    };

    // 6. Create GenerationContext with target_plugin set
    let mut ctx = op_gallery_gen::context::GenerationContext::new(
        catalog_load.schemas,
        catalog_load.catalog_hash,
        catalog_guard.prompt().to_string(),
    );
    ctx.target_plugin = Some(target_plugin);

    // 7. Run one inference turn via InferenceLoop
    let inference = op_gallery_gen::InferenceLoop::new(
        config.zeroclaw_endpoint.clone(),
        1, // single turn for preview
    );
    
    let generated = match inference.generate(&ctx).await {
        Ok(spec) => spec,
        Err(e) => return ok(json!({ "errors": [e.to_string()] })),
    };

    // 8. Validate result with CatalogGuard
    let mut errors = Vec::new();
    // Use the validator to check the spec
    let validator = op_gallery_gen::SpecValidator::new();
    if let Err(validation_errors) = validator.validate(&generated.spec) {
        for ve in validation_errors {
            errors.push(ve.message);
        }
    }
    // Also check with catalog guard for component validity
    if let Some(elements) = generated.spec.get("elements").and_then(|e| e.as_object()) {
        for (id, element) in elements {
            let mut elem_errors = Vec::new();
            catalog_guard.check_element(id, element, &mut elem_errors);
            for ee in elem_errors {
```
